newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Send Deng's ashes to Hong Kong - political party.
newsitem.headline: Send Deng's ashes to Hong Kong - political party.

text.p: Hong Kong's largest pro-Beijing party wrote to the family of China's late paramount leader on Friday to request that some of his ashes be sent to the territory to mark its handover to Chinese rule in July.

"We hope you can keep a part of Mr Deng's ashes until after Hong Kong's return to China in July 1997, to be scattered in the seas of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region in order to fulfill his last wish to come here himself after the return," said the Democratic Alliance for the Betterment of Hong Kong.
Hong Kong reverts to China at midnight on June 30 when more than 150 years of British colonial rule ends. Deng is credited with securing the return of Hong Kong.
Deng died on Wednesday night at age 92, just 132 days before he would have seen his dream of reuniting Hong Kong with China come true.
His family has said Deng wanted to donate his corneas to an eye bank, give his body for medical research, and have his ashes scattered at sea.
